messages:
riley: deploy-bot starting staged rollout v2.6.3 -> canary 3% in ap-southeast. change window ends 02:00 UTC. please watch memory and embed latency dashboards :eyes:
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout initiated: v2.6.3 -> canary=3% | regions=[ap-southeast-1] | CL#4987
amar: quick FYI: unusual mem allocation spikes on two canary replicas at ~t+4m, p95 mem jumped ~40% then recovered. not yet 5xx but noisy
sophia: linking logs: https://telemetry.redwood/trace/4987-apspike 1; also seeing repeated GC pauses around the same times
amar: GC pauses + mem spike pattern points to new allocator in runtime 2.6.3 (jemalloc tune). build metadata shows jemalloc tune=aggressive in this image
riley: how many pods hit it? any node pressure?
amar: only 2/18 canary pods, nodes not under pressure, no OOMKills reported so far. kube events clear
sophia: QA: running a long sequence suite now that exercises embeddings and kv cache; will post failure repro if we see it. about 12m left
riley: ops: since it's limited, i'd prefer an immediate hold of progression to avoid accidental ramp. can we freeze?
deploy-bot: action queued: freeze progression. canary remains at 3%. notifications: #eng-oncall #eng-releases #infra
infra-bot: recorded incident marker: incident_candidate=true | title="canary-memory-spike-jemalloc"
amar: mitigation options: (1) pin jemalloc tuning back to conservative and redeploy canary image (CL#4988), (2) increase memory limit for canary pods temporarily, (3) continue monitoring and let canary stay but block further percent increases
sophia: QA note: repro attempts failing so far, long-run tests still in progress. repro would confirm allocator change as cause
riley: leaning to option (1) since it's config-only and reversible. pin will require a new image build but quick. any objections?
amar: +1. i'll prepare CL#4988 to set jemalloc=tune=conservative and bake a canary image. ETA ~9m
sophia: once CL is ready QA will rerun failing suite against pinned image. if it shows improvement, we'll resume to 10% then follow normal ramp. if not, full rollback to v2.6.2 is fallback
deploy-bot: freeze confirmed. canary remains at 3% until explicit resume or rollback
riley: approvals: amar +1, sophia +1, need infra lead +1 to merge CL#4988
amar: pinging @infra-lead for quick +1
infra-bot: infra-lead approval received via internal flow at 2026-03-23T12:10:01Z. merging allowed
amar: merging CL#4988 and starting build pipeline now :hammer_and_wrench:
ops note: when we redeploy, please avoid simultaneous scale-up events. set autoscaler hold for canary group for 20m
ops-bot: autoscaler hold applied for group=inf-canary ap-southeast for 20m
sophia: smoke script to run after redeploy: ```./smoke_embed.sh --env=canary --samples=200 --long=50``` will post results in thread
amar: new image pushed: inf-runtime:jemalloc-conservative-4988 -> rolling restart initiated
ops-bot: pods restarting (rolling) - expected downtime per pod ~40s
sophia: smoke summary: p95 mem reduced ~22% on the quick suite, GC pause frequency down, no 5xx observed during the run
riley: sounds good. proposal: if extended run (30m) remains stable, resume to 10% and continue staggered ramp. rollback only if regressions return. all in favor? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
amar: :+1:
sophia: :+1: will continue monitoring long-run cases
riley: i'll update release notes: add line "hold: observed transient memory/GC spikes on canary; temporarily pinned jemalloc tune to conservative (CL#4988); monitoring extended" and extend change window if needed
deploy-bot: note: rollout frozen at canary=3% until explicit resume. record updated: changelog_note_added=true
ops-bot: monitoring hooks set: mem/p95 alerting threshold tightened for canary group during extended validation
riley: tagging for postmortem if we end up rolling back. thanks team, keep posting any anomalies here.
